lesson: Inclusion scale 0.3-0.5 + heavy allocation (24/13/13) is the proven sweet spot: best inclusion AP (0.41) and best worst-class AP, confirming missed inclusions are a scale problem, not a source-identity problem (appearance-matched sources did not help). prefer_small source weighting is harmful for thin-line scratches (AP -0.06) — keep uniform weighting there. If iterating further, the only untested inclusion lever left is going even smaller (0.3-0.4) or raising max_overlap; do not touch scratch/patch scale.
